preconditions.description: The length of array a is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.
The length of array b is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element in array a is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b_i <= 10**9 for b_i in b)
preconditions.description: Each element in array b is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(b[i] < b[i + 1] for i in range(m - 1))
preconditions.description: Array b is sorted in strictly ascending order.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer less than 998244353.
The output is the number of ways to divide array a into m consecutive subarrays such that the minimum of the i-th subarray is equal to b_i, modulo 998244353.
